name: public-ct-ed-data
title: Public Connecticut Education Data Release
description: Public Connecticut education datasets from CT EdSight, with CPI-U deflators from FRED, Education Cost Sharing (ECS) grant amounts from CSDE, ECS formula inputs from the official OFA/CSDE calculation shells (FY2019-FY2027) and the School and State Finance Project, CSDE net current expenditures per pupil, and SEDA achievement estimates.

sources.title: CSDE Bureau of Fiscal Services, ECS grant documents
School and State Finance Project, ECS formula tools
Office of Fiscal Analysis / CSDE per-town ECS calculation shells (received from the state by email, 2026-09-15; not posted online)
Massachusetts DESE, FY2025 Chapter 70 formula spreadsheet and white paper
NCES Common Core of Data via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal
BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages

resources.name: town_year_ma_inputs
resources.title: Town-year inputs for a Massachusetts Chapter 70 style rule
resources.description: Town-year inputs for a Massachusetts Chapter 70 style rule (town x fiscal_year). Source: NCES Common Core of Data enrollment by grade (Urban Institute Education Data Portal API); BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages; Census ACS 5-year table B19025; OPM Equalized Net Grand List by Town; ECS worksheets.

fields.name: town_code
fields.description: Connecticut town code, 1-169 (alphabetical); equals the local board of education's CSDE district code.

fields.name: town
fields.description: Town name.

fields.name: fiscal_year
fields.description: Fiscal year ending in the listed calendar year; FY2026 corresponds to school year 2025-26.

fields.name: ccd_year
fields.description: NCES Common Core of Data school year (fall) whose enrollment by grade supplies the grade mix; fiscal year t uses t-2, the ECS count date.

fields.name: grade_source
fields.description: Where the grade mix comes from: local (the town's own district), region (its share of a regional district), both, or statewide shares when neither exists.

fields.name: free_share_of_frpl
fields.description: Free-lunch-eligible students as a share of all FRPL-eligible students in the town's district(s), EdSight enrollment (latest year with data up to t).

fields.name: free_share_year
fields.description: Fiscal year of the EdSight enrollment used for free_share_of_frpl.

fields.name: free_lunch_count
fields.description: Low-income basis 'free lunch only': frpl_count x free_share_of_frpl (130% of poverty or direct certification).

fields.name: direct_cert_share
fields.description: Low-income basis 'direct certification': CSDE Community Eligibility Provision identified-student percentage of the town's district(s) (SNAP, Temporary Family Assistance, Medicaid, foster care, homeless, migrant matches), weighted by where resident students sit; nearest CEP year.

fields.name: direct_cert_year
fields.description: Fiscal year of the CEP notification used (2024-2026).

fields.name: direct_cert_count
fields.description: resident_students x direct_cert_share; blank for towns absent from the CEP list (the explorer falls back to the free-lunch count).

fields.name: share_pk
fields.description: Share of resident students in pre-kindergarten.

fields.name: share_k
fields.description: Share of resident students in kindergarten.

fields.name: share_el
fields.description: Share of resident students in grades 1-5.

fields.name: share_ms
fields.description: Share of resident students in grades 6-8.

fields.name: share_hs
fields.description: Share of resident students in grades 9-12.

fields.name: county
fields.description: County (the labor-market-area proxy for the wage adjustment factor).

fields.name: wage_year
fields.description: Calendar year of the QCEW average pay used (t-2; 2023 is the last county-coded year).

fields.name: county_wage_ratio
fields.description: County average annual pay, all covered jobs, divided by the Connecticut average (BLS QCEW).

fields.name: wage_adjustment_factor
fields.description: 1 + (county_wage_ratio - 1)/3, not less than 1 (MGL c.70 s.2 rule with the county as labor market area).

fields.name: eqv_grand_list_year
fields.description: Grand-list year of the equalized net grand list used (the latest in the ECS window, t-4).

fields.name: equalized_valuation
fields.description: OPM equalized net grand list, dollars (Chapter 70's equalized valuation).

fields.name: income_vintage
fields.description: ACS 5-year vintage of the aggregate household income (t-4).

fields.name: aggregate_household_income
fields.description: ACS 5-year aggregate household income, table B19025, dollars (Chapter 70 uses tax-return personal income).

fields.name: resident_students
fields.description: Resident students the town is fiscally responsible for (ECS definition), October-1 count.

fields.name: frpl_count
fields.description: Students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, October-1 PSIS.

fields.name: ell_count
fields.description: English learners, October-1 PSIS.

fields.name: alliance_or_psd
fields.description: 1 if an Alliance District or Priority School District that year (ECS worksheet).
